candidates.name: cherre
candidates.description: cherre is the leader in real estate data and insight. we connect decision makers to accurate property and market information, and help them make faster, smarter decisions. by providing a unique “single source of truth,” cherre empowers customers to evaluate opportunities and trends faster and more accurately, while saving millions of dollars in manual data collection and analytics costs.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate data and insights to property owners and asset managers for portfolio and property decision-making.

candidates.name: compstak®
candidates.description: compstak is the leading commercial real estate data and analytics platform, built on the industry's most comprehensive crowdsourced database of lease comps, sale comps, loan data, and property information.trusted by the world's largest real estate investors, lenders, and advisors, including wells fargo, tishman speyer, aew, cim, and moody's, compstak gives cre professionals the granular, verified data they need to underwrite faster, negotiate smarter, and invest with confidence.our data solutions include:lease comps · sale comps · cmbs & loan data · property information · portfolio analytics · market reportskey data points: starting rent, net effective rent, free rent, tenant improvements, cap rates, noi, loan-to-value, lease expirations, and more.what sets compstak apart:• 40,000+ contributing brokers, appraisers & researchers across the u.s.• 2.33m+ commercial properties covered nationwide• multi-step data verification using machine learning, statistical anomaly detection, and cre analyst review• ai-powered analytics built on top of the most granular cre dataset availablewhether you're a lender, landlord, private equity investor, reit, asset manager, or cre broker, compstak gives you the edge to move first and deal smarter.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate data and analytics to landlords, asset managers, investors, and brokers for leasing and portfolio decisions.

candidates.name: dealpath
candidates.description: dealpath is the ai-powered operating system for real estate investment. to date, dealpath has powered over $10 trillion in transactions in partnership with hundreds of firms, from leading global institutions including blackstone, nuveen, lasalle, cbre im, metlife, to numerous mid-market and regional organizations. dealpath supports the full investment lifecycle from sourcing to portfolio management, driving performance by uniting the private exchange for real estate listings, market intelligence, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows.if you’re a passionate commercial real estate or software professional interested in joining a fast-growing team and helping power an $18 trillion industry – we would love to hear from you. visit our careers page to apply for open roles.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate operating software for institutional owners, overlapping in asset/portfolio management, property data, and investment workflows.

candidates.name: eliseai
candidates.description: fixing housing and healthcare with agentic ai to improve how we live.
candidates.rationale: EliseAI automates leasing and resident communications for multifamily housing, while VTS serves commercial real-estate leasing and asset-management teams; buyers and use cases differ.

candidates.name: hqo
candidates.description: hqo is leading the transformation of the way people experience real estate by converging data, technology, and the customer. through its real estate experience (rex) platform—a powerful and dynamic suite of applications and services—hqo has powered over 400 million square feet at over 700 properties across 32 countries. the world’s most innovative organizations rely on hqo to drive operational excellence by maximizing and boosting tenant and employee acquisition, retention, and engagement. for more information, visit www.hqo.com.
candidates.rationale: HqO’s real-estate experience platform overlaps VTS’s tenant-experience and property-operations offerings, targeting the same commercial property owners and operators.

candidates.name: lane
candidates.description: lane is the world’s leading workplace experience platform. founded in 2014 to transform and connect the workplace, our no-code enterprise software streamlines all aspects of day-to-day office life—from room bookings and access management, to communications and commerce, to events, data, and beyond. our award-winning mobile and web technology is built to scale, allowing workplace providers to deploy globally and configure locally. powering 300+ properties across 22 major cities in 8 countries, lane clients include brookfield, oxford, colliers, dream, nuveen, studio by tishman speyer, and more. putting all of the pieces together, lane turns any workplace into a place that works.www.joinlane.comwww.twitter.com/joinlanewww.instagram.com/join_lane
candidates.rationale: Lane’s workplace and tenant-experience platform overlaps VTS’s tenant-experience offering and targets the same commercial property owners and operators.

candidates.name: juniper square
candidates.description: juniper square is trusted as the fund operations partner to more than 2,000 private markets gps worldwide, connecting market-leading technology, data, and fund administration services to help gps fundraise efficiently, streamline operations, and improve the investor experience. our unified platform centralizes data and connects lps and gps across every workflow—including fundraising, investor onboarding, compliance, treasury, reporting, and more. today, more than 40,000 funds, 700,000 lp accounts, and $1 trillion in lp capital are managed through juniper square.
candidates.rationale: Juniper Square manages private-market fund and investor operations, not commercial-property leasing, tenant experience, or building asset operations.

candidates.name: northspyre
candidates.description: transforming real estate development with automation, analytics, and ai.our purpose-built platform empowers developers to reduce risk, gain real-time visibility, and accelerate decision-making across the entire project lifecycle.by streamlining workflows and delivering actionable insights, northspyre enables teams to deliver projects on time and on budget.since 2017, leading development firms have trusted northspyre as the backbone of their operational infrastructure. today, the platform supports more than $500 billion in projects, driving a new era of smarter, data-driven real estate development.
candidates.rationale: Northspyre manages real estate development projects, while VTS focuses on leasing and operating existing commercial properties; their core jobs differ.

candidates.name: reonomy
candidates.description: reonomy is the leading provider of cre insights, empowering top brokerages, financial institutions, and commercial services providers with actionable data and solutions.armed with reonomy’s enterprise-grade products, cre professionals and organizations gain comprehensive market understanding, discover opportunities, and streamline research processes.headquartered in new york, reonomy has raised $128 million from top investors, including sapphire ventures, bain capital, softbank, primary ventures, georgian partners, wells fargo strategic capital, citi ventures, and untitled investments. our clients represent the biggest names in cre, including newmark knight frank, cbre, cushman & wakefield, and tishman speyer. reonomy was acquired by altus group on november 11, 2021.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial real estate data and insights to CRE professionals for market research, opportunity discovery, and asset-related decision-making.

candidates.name: vts rise
candidates.description: vts rise specializes in property operations and tenant experience. as part of the vts offering, we provide landlords with a full-service platform that continues the journey of digitizing the entire asset experience. follow us at @wearevts for the latest news.
candidates.rationale: VTS Rise is explicitly part of VTS’s own offering, making it a product/division duplicate rather than an independent lookalike company.
